title: Infinity Gauntlet Mace
description: turns your mace into an Infinity Gauntlet
body:
Infinity Gauntlet Mace

Turn the ordinary Minecraft Mace into the legendary Infinity Gauntlet!

This lightweight resource pack replaces the default Mace with a custom-made 3D Infinity Gauntlet model, featuring detailed textures and carefully adjusted positions for first-person, third-person, inventory, ground, and item-frame views.

🔴 Features
Custom 3D Infinity Gauntlet model
Detailed Infinity Stones design
Replaces only the vanilla Mace
Optimized first-person and third-person positioning
Custom inventory and dropped-item appearance
Lightweight and performance-friendly
No OptiFine or additional mods required
🔴 Installation
Download the resource pack.
Place the ZIP file inside your Minecraft resourcepacks folder.
Open Minecraft and go to Options → Resource Packs.
Enable Infinity Gauntlet Mace.
